transcript: He ran with his fist out and the spike out ahead of it, and he did not think about the shape at all, and it held, and when a husk came off the eastern bank he did not aim, he put his arm out the way you put an arm out to stop a door, and it went through, and the thing dropped. Then he got excited, and thought yes, that, again, bigger, and the spike guttered and shrank and went out and was a gray slab in his fist, and a husk hit him in the hip and knocked him into the wheel. Torrin, Milo, from the cart bed, both hands full of Senna's blankets. Torrin, he got up. His hip didn't work right. Behind, the wall gone and the road full. Torrin stood at his father's shoulder with a crooked gray spike sticking out of the bottom of his fist and both ends of the world closing.
